rubrics.justification: Accurately identifies an early blastocyst with a small blastocoel, absent/degenerative ICM and poor TE consistent with 0DD. Minor overinterpretation includes assigning a typical ICM clock-face location and describing cell appearance details that are only partly discernible from the image.

Integrates age, elevated FSH, low mature oocyte yield, BMI, male factor context, sperm parameters, and endometrial thickness well with embryo prognosis. Slight overreach in labeling diminished ovarian reserve without AMH and in inferring occult ovarian aging from limited data.

Overall logic is clear and consistent: very poor morphology plus age-related aneuploidy risk leads to very low implantation potential. Minor issues include some speculative causal claims about sperm DNA fragmentation and ovarian reserve.

Core grading interpretation and guarded prognosis are aligned with standard IVF practice, and counseling around poor prognosis is appropriate. However, several future-cycle suggestions (routine high-dose stimulation, growth hormone, co-culture, IMSI/PICSI/TESE based on speculation) are not strongly guideline-supported.

Provides practical options for this embryo (transfer vs extended culture vs no transfer) and concrete future planning steps with counseling. Some recommendations are more speculative than standard-of-care, but overall the advice is specific and usable.
